content: आसञ्ज् €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To fasten, fix on, attach to, join or add to, place or put on (dress, armour <ab>&c.</ab>); चापमासज्यकण्ठे <ls>Ku. 2. 64</ls>; अनुबन्ध आसज्यते <ls>Sk.</ls>; आसज्यमानेक्षणः <ls>Ś. 3. 25</ls> with the eyes intently fixed; (<ab>fig.</ab> also); भुजे … स भूमेर्धुरमाससञ्ज <ls>R. 2. 74</ls>; so पुत्रे राज्यम्; जने दोषम् <ab>&c.</ab>; आससञ्ज भयं तेषाम् <ls>Bk. 14. 104</ls> fear overtook them. .²2 To confer upon, conduce to; तिष्ठतां तपसि पुण्यमासजन् <ls>Ki. 13. 44</ls>. .²3 To stick or adhere to, depend upon. .²4 To take up. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To cause to attach, have anything fastened or put on. .²2 To place, put, throw round; आसञ्जयामास यथाप्रदेशं कण्ठे गुणम् <ls>R. 6. 83</ls>. .²3 To entrust or appoint. {%<ab>pass.</ab>%} (सज्यते) To adhere, stick, be attached; यदि नेष्टात्मनः पीडा मासञ्जि भवता जने <ls>Ki. 11. 29</ls>; <ab>cf.</ab> “Do unto others as you would be done by”.
